name: andywiecko/PBD2D
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; no full audit/build/benchmark
finding: Sequential IJob distance projection uses compliance/dt² and extra stiffness factor, guards small weight sum/edge length, no accumulated lambda in viewed job. Component jobs chain dependencies; this particular job is not a parallel edge kernel.

name: RefinedCode/SoftbodySimulation
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; no full audit/build/benchmark
finding: Read random radius-based cluster construction, mass-weighted center and inverse rest covariance. Hardcoded cluster radius=0.7 and unchecked covariance inverse need scale/degeneracy validation; shape-matching setup is not a calibrated constitutive FEM law.

name: dmitrykurash/holocloth
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; no full audit/build/benchmark
finding: Fixed substep accumulator clamps incoming dt and discards backlog at MAX_SUBSTEPS; per-substep exponential damping, in-place Laplacian smoothing and distance relaxation, grab corrections. Visual smoothing and lost time should not drive physiological state clocks.

name: learn-computer-graphics/physics
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; no full audit/build/benchmark
finding: GLSL reads old position/velocity buffers, accumulates neighbor springs, global velocity damping and wind, writes p+v*dt+0.5*a*dt² and v+a*dt, pins top vertices. Requires zero-length normalization and buffer/dispatch coverage checks; shader comment alone does not establish an integrator guarantee.

name: steampower33/XPBD-Cloth
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; no full audit/build/benchmark
finding: Vulkan host stage iterates color ranges, dispatches stretch constraints and inserts SSBO write-to-read/write barrier between colors; supplies compliance/beta/stiffness through push constants. Disjoint vertex coloring and actual kernel must still be verified; host barriers alone are insufficient.
